description: This file contains functions for merging and dumping code coverage profiles, specifically for handling multiple `go test -coverprofile` results. It includes functions to add profiles, merge profiles, and output coverage data, and references the 'golang.org/x/tools/cover' package.

methods.name: AddCoverProfile
methods.description: Adds a coverage profile to a list, merging if a profile with the same filename exists.

methods.name: DumpCoverProfiles
methods.description: Outputs the coverage profiles to an io.Writer in a specific format.

methods.name: MergeCoverProfiles
methods.description: Merges two coverage profiles, ensuring they have the same mode.
